summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py gained `import enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins str-enum with eleven commented members. botocore/args.py gained the EPRBuiltins import, a None-tolerant STS predicate (no variant tags when config is absent), and ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean. tests/unit/test_args.py gained TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py and tests/unit/test_regions.py pass (161 passed). Full tests/unit run: 11 failures, all in session tests (test_session.py and test_session_legacy.py, e.g. test_internal_component), not yet checked against the untouched repo; 3141 passed, 66 skipped. Not verified: black/isort (not installed in the shared venv); awk line-length check passes except args.py:315, which predates this change. Nothing committed.
